text: The Patriots are getting significant reinforcements for their Week 6 showdown against the Jets on Sunday, October 18th at 1 PM ET, as A.J. Brown has been activated from injured reserve after missing the past four games with a right high ankle sprain, though the star wideout indicated his status remains "still up in the air" heading into the matchup. Joining Brown's return to the lineup are OL Will Campbell (knee) and RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), along with CB Christian Gonzalez, while the team elevated S Elliott Davison from the practice squad for the game. The Patriots arrive off their best performance of the season—a commanding 28-point victory—and will face a Jets team led by QB Geno Smith, who's bringing an impressive no-interception streak into the contest, putting New England on upset alert despite their recent momentum.
